stages.desc: If project unseeded (.agents/* absent), pause for scout — do not dispatch blind.
Analyst writes the Automation-Friendly Spec + a status.
Only ready-for-automation / extend-existing advances to the implementer.
Manual-run-before-automate, then automate; returns PR + Run Report.
Adversarial test-honesty review in a FRESH session.
Tal's own gate: N consecutive green live-runs in Tal's session before merge.
Merge + file follow-ups + back-write TMS + close tracker.
